description:
The most secure collaboration platform.


Improvement
- Native Windows MSI installer with managed server configuration.
- Corrected Windows managed-device detection.
- System regional locale exposed to the web app.
- German and Swedish translation updates.
- General bug fixes.

- Deutsche und schwedische Übersetzungen aktualisiert.
- Allgemeine Fehlerbehebungen.
